d59ba3.title: SAST-Recon baseline artifacts (CHOME /workspace/bodega)
d59ba3.content:
## SAST baseline artifacts (all under /workspace/.source-aware/)

- `semgrep.json` — 59 results / 3073 files scanned (p/default + typescript + javascript + secrets)
- `ast-grep.json` — 102,575 structural matches over 2000 files (`sg run --pattern '$F($$$ARGS)'`); `sg-targets.txt` derived from semgrep paths.scanned
- `gitleaks.json` — 12 generic-api-key hits (11 test fixtures + 1 client constant `hint_compras_v2` = false positive)
- `trufflehog.json` — 47 detections; real: `.env.local` Postgres DSN, `.env.example` placeholder DSN; rest are .git-object history / node_modules / .next cache false positives
- `trivy-fs.json` — 5 npm CVEs (browserslist@4.28.2 x2, fast-uri@3.1.2 x3), all CVSS 7.5 (HIGH), all transitive build-tooling deps
- `sinks.txt` — dangerous-sink grep (2309 lines, mostly drizzle `sql` template usage — parameterized)
- `ssrf-files.txt` — 7 client files using fetch (integration clients only)
- `api-routes-code.txt` / `page-routes-code.txt` — pre-existing route dumps in artifact dir

## Key source review conclusions

- Auth: NextAuth Credentials + bcrypt(12) + RBAC cache (5s TTL) + per-IP/per-email rate limits; password reset tokens hashed (sha256) + 1h TTL + single-use; registration uses advisory locks; login uses timing-safe dummy hash. Solid.
- Worksite scoping: `resolveWorksiteScope`/`canAccessWorksite` enforced in every reviewed file-serving route (attachments, flota, mantenciones, evidence, mapa, pdtp, soporte, repuestos/servicios quotaciones, purchase invoices). IDOR surface well-covered.
- File uploads: magic-byte MIME validation + size caps + zip-envelope limits + generated storage names; path traversal blocked in all serve routes.
- Crypto: AES-256-GCM with explicit setAuthTag (semgrep gcm-no-tag-length are false positives).
- Proxy (proxy.ts): CSP + auth gate + module toggles; cron routes protected by CRON_SECRET timingSafeEqual. Matcher excludes `.*\..*` static files from proxy but all download handlers self-auth.
- No eval/child_process/dynamic SQL sinks in app code (all drizzle `sql` templates parameterized).

## Top candidates for downstream dynamic validation

1. `scripts/dbq.mjs` — HARDCODED live DB credentials (postgres://bodega_dev:<pw>@127.0.0.1:5433/bodega_dev) + plaintext password `Chgo1314` for allopze@gmail.com (also in git history 94c1cc4 and scripts/qa-*.mjs, .env.qa)
2. `.env.local` / `.env.development.local` — populated AUTH_SECRET, CRON_SECRET, PREVENTION_DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY, DB pw, third-party API creds (dev clone, gitignored, but present on disk)
3. SCA: browserslist 4.28.2 (CVE-2026-73088, CVE-2026-73089), fast-uri 3.1.2 (CVE-2026-13676, CVE-2026-16221, CVE-2026-18446) — all HIGH 7.5, transitive
4. `lib/services/billing/reconciliation.ts:199` — `new RegExp` with user-influenced folio (numeric, low risk)
5. `app/(app)/prevencion/pdtp/[programId]/program-lifecycle-controls.tsx:254` — non-literal RegExp (client-side, low risk)
6. `components/ui/chart.tsx:74` + `admin/plantillas/template-list.tsx:247` — dangerouslySetInnerHTML (client-side, template preview; check if admin-supplied body is sanitized)
7. Public TAE API (`/api/tae/access|identity|submit`) — token-gated public endpoints; worth testing token brute-force/reuse
8. `app/api/health` unauthenticated — info disclosure (DB/storage status)
9. Dockerfile runs as root (missing-user semgrep ERROR)
10. `.npmrc` min-release-age not set (supply-chain hardening)

Not vulnerabilities on their own (validated as guarded): all file-serving routes, health/clinical/reserved-case services, upload validation, cron auth.

c6a22c.title: CHOME auth/RBAC map
c6a22c.content:
## CHOME auth/RBAC map (source-based, for dynamic testing)

### Authn model
- NextAuth v5 (beta.32) **Credentials + JWT session strategy** (`lib/auth/auth.ts:77` `session: { strategy: "jwt" }`), `trustHost: true`, secret from `AUTH_SECRET` (list incl. `AUTH_SECRET_PREVIOUS` rotation). Cookie name `authjs.session-token` (prefix `__Secure-`/`__Host-` when HTTPS), httpOnly, sameSite=lax, secure only when HTTPS (`@auth/core/src/lib/utils/cookie.ts` defaults).
- JWT callback **re-fetches RBAC from DB on every request** (bypassing cache) → revocations apply immediately; roles/permissions/worksiteIds embedded in token & session (`rbac.ts`, `auth.ts` jwt/session callbacks).
- Login: bcrypt compare with dummy-hash anti-timing; per-IP + per-email persistent rate limit (5/15min) in `lib/services/rate-limit.ts`; custom error codes ip_rate_limited/email_rate_limited. Password setup pending (`pending-password:*` marker) blocks login.
- Temporary substitute accounts enforced at auth time (`temporary-account.ts`).

### Roles (system-rbac.ts) & hierarchy
Global (isGlobal=true): administrador (ALL permissions), jefa_chome, secretaria, prevencionista, jefe_mantencion, gerente_legal_rrhh, subgerente_operaciones. Faena-scoped: solicitante_faena, prevencionista_faena, conductor_lider, admin_contrato, jefe_terreno, supervisor_terreno, cphs. Role→permission grants derived from module manifests (`modules/*/manifest.ts` defaultGrants), admin gets every permission.

### Permission helpers (`lib/auth/can.ts`)
`can()`/`canAny()` check session.user.permissions; `requirePermission()` (throws) & `guardPermission()` (ActionState) enforce permission + module-toggle; `requireAuth()`/`guardAuth()` session-only. NOTE: several handlers use `auth()` + manual `can()` checks.

### Faena scoping (`lib/auth/scope.ts`)
- `isGlobalRole()` → session.isGlobal or GLOBAL_ROLES fallback; `canAccessWorksite()`; `visibleWorksiteIds()`; `resolveWorksiteScope()` → {all|some|none}; `worksiteScopeSql()` predicate (intersects requested worksite with role scope); `serviceWorksiteScope()`.
- Enforced in most services via resolveWorksiteScope/visibleWorksiteIds/buildWorksiteFilter(export module). **Key areas to probe**: reportes/export `gasto_faena`+`dte_libro_compras` (DTE ignores faena), admin/catalogos/export productos/proveedores (no faena scope), dtes/[id]/pdf (purchasing:view only, no faena).

### Route inventory (app/api, 90 handlers)
- Public (no session): /api/auth/*, /api/health, /api/cron/* (CRON_SECRET), /api/backups/config (CRON_SECRET), /api/tae/{access,submit,identity} (public token+rate-limit), /api/ppa (public form).
- Session+permission+faena-scope: most prevention routes, bodega exports, attachments, documentos, miper, pdtp, facturacion, trazabilidad, entregas, flota/mantenciones docs, repuestos/servicios cotizaciones.
- Session only (no role check): /api/notifications (userId from session — OK), /api/backups/status+drive-health (can admin:backups), /api/health public.
- `[!!]` flags for dynamic validation:
  - `/api/reportes/export` tipo=dte_libro_compras — no faena scope (codEmp only) [medium]
  - `/api/admin/catalogos/export` productos/proveedores — no faena scope; trabajadores uses worksiteScopeSql [check]
  - `/api/purchase-orders/dtes/[id]/pdf` — purchasing:view only, no faena link [check]
  - `/api/prevencion/inspecciones/documento|evidence` — per-file faena check via DB path join (good)
  - `/api/cron/*` — 20 routes secret-only, no source allowlist (dev) [config observation]
- Detail routes with [id] (archivos-sensibles, casos-reservados, salud/clinical, privacidad) do scope checks in service; good 404 uniformity.

### Server actions
- All substantive actions use guardPermission/requirePermission/guardAuth/requireAuth (checked across compras, solicitudes, admin/*, combustibles, pdtp, soporte, flota, bodega, entregas, recepcion, aprobaciones, trazabilidad, facturacion, prevencion/*). Public: (auth)/registro, (auth)/recuperar, (public)/ppa.
- Solicitudes actions-module re-checks auth+worksite on every action (draft/submit/delete/cancel) — good. Quotation workflow (lib/requests/request-actions-workflow.ts) checks owner+worksite.
- No action file found lacking server-side authz in the sampled set.

### Password flows
- Forgot: rate-limited per-IP (recuperar:ip), always-succeed anti-enumeration, 80ms dummy delay, 256-bit hex token stored sha256-hashed, 1h TTL, single-use, transaction apply. Solid. `/api/health` public exposes DB/storage status.
- Registration: invitation-gated (hashInvitationToken), email-match enforced, roleIdsJson/worksiteAssignmentsJson from invitation (admin-created), advisory lock for first-admin.

### CORS/cookies/headers
- No CORS middleware; proxy.ts sets CSP (nonce+strict-dynamic), next.config headers: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS. Session cookie secure only behind HTTPS; allowedDevOrigins bodega.allopze.dev/bodega.chome.dev (dev-only).
- proxy.ts protects all routes except listed public paths; matcher covers /api/:path* (incl. dot-files) + non-static pages. Module-toggle blocking at proxy + handler level.

### E2E test accounts (for dynamic testing): admin@e2e.chome.cl/chome2026, jefe.faena@e2e.chome.cl/chome2026, comprador@e2e.chome.cl/chome2026, prevencion.lectura@e2e.chome.cl/chome2026, scoped@e2e.chome.cl/scoped2026 (solicitante_faena, only ws-e2e; ws-restricted-e2e exists for scope tests).

e94e52.title: CHOME live recon map
e94e52.content:
## CHOME live recon map (host.docker.internal:3001, dev mode)

### Tech stack
- Next.js 16.2.12 (dev mode, Turbopack, `X-Powered-By: Next.js`, `b=development` RSC marker), React 19.2.4
- NextAuth 5.0.0-beta.32 (Auth.js v5, credentials provider only), JWE session split into 3 cookies `authjs.session-token.{0,1,2}`
- Drizzle ORM 0.45.2 + `postgres` driver (PostgreSQL), Zod 4 validation, bcryptjs, @tanstack/react-query, Sentry @sentry/nextjs 10.59, resend (email), maplibre-gl, tesseract/pdfjs OCR, exceljs exports
- App uses Server Actions (RSC) for most mutations; limited REST `/api/**` routes (99 route files) mainly for exports/uploads/auth/attachments

### Auth
- Login: `POST /api/auth/callback/credentials` (CSRF required). QA creds work: allopze@gmail.com / Chgo1314 (note: `.env.qa` had trailing dot; actual password no dot)
- Session cookie: `authjs.session-token.0/1/2` — HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, **no Secure flag** (dev HTTP), Expires ~30d (2026-10-02). Auth.js CSRF cookie HttpOnly+Lax.
- Session user: id `iWkuQZgqndE1Px8R2vOca`, roles: supervisor_faena, administrador, jefa_chome, secretaria, prevencionista, solicitante_faena, prevencionista_faena, jefe_mantencion, conductor_lider, admin_contrato, jefe_terreno, cphs — 241 permissions (admin:* full)
- Origin binding: app configured for `localhost:3001` (AUTH_URL); requests via host.docker.internal need cookies set for that host; browser fetch from host.docker.internal origin to /api/auth/* fails (origin mismatch / proxy), so in-browser auth flow is blocked in this env
- `/api/auth/providers` returns only credentials provider; `/api/auth/session` null anonymous; `/api/auth/csrf` works anonymously

### Public (no auth) endpoints/pages
- `GET /api/health` — **leaks internal status anonymously**: `{"status":"degraded","db":"connected","storage":"unreachable","disk":{"freePercent":83,...}}`
- `GET /registro` — public self-registration page (Server Action form with token field)
- `GET /recuperar` (+ `/recuperar/[token]`) — public password-recovery page
- `GET /ppa`, `/ppa/result/[token]`, `/tae`, `/tae/access/[accessToken]` (200 for arbitrary token `test`), `/tae/resultado/[token]` — public modules
- `POST /api/tae/identity` (RUT validation), `POST /api/tae/access` (returns 404 ok:false for bad token) — public APIs
- `/api/auth/error`, `/api/auth/signout` — 302

### Auth-only (307 to /login anonymously)
- All `/api/notifications`, `/api/backups/*`, `/api/bodega/*`, `/api/entregas/export`, `/api/trazabilidad/export`, `/api/reportes/export`, `/api/prevencion/**`, `/api/purchase-orders/**`, `/api/attachments/[id]`, `/api/mantenciones/documentos/[id]`, `/api/flota/documentos/[id]`, `/api/soporte/adjuntos/[id]`, `/api/combustibles/*`, `/api/dte-portal/*`, `/api/repuestos/quotaciones/[id]`, `/api/servicios/cotizaciones/[id]`, `/api/cron/*` (all cron guarded by auth; `/api/cron` also 307)
- Exports work authenticated (XLSX via exceljs): /api/entregas/export, /api/trazabilidad/export, /api/reportes/export
- `/api/bodega/opciones?faena=...` validates faena existence (returns error for unknown)

### App modules/pages (200 authenticated)
- `/dashboard`, `/admin` (+ /admin/usuarios, /admin/auditoria, /admin/backups, /admin/seguridad, /admin/faenas, /admin/roles, /admin/seguridad, etc.), `/analitica`, `/aprobaciones`, `/bodega` (+guias, documentos), `/combustibles` (+tae, anomalias, importar, etc.), `/compras`, `/control-operacional`, `/entregas`, `/facturacion`, `/flota`, `/mantenciones`, `/pendientes`, `/perfil`, `/prevencion` (large subtree: pdtp, incidentes, inspecciones, documentacion, capa, capacitacion, permisos, salud, privacidad, etc.), `/recepcion`, `/reportes`, `/solicitudes`, `/soporte`, `/trazabilidad`
- 199 page routes total in code; `/repuestos`, `/servicios`, `/notificaciones` legacy paths 307/404 (merged into solicitudes)

### Security headers (present on all responses)
- X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy (camera/mic/geo=()), Strict-Transport-Security max-age=63072000 includeSubDomains preload, CSP with per-request nonce + 'strict-dynamic' (script-src also 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'), frame-ancestors 'none', form-action 'self'
- No Access-Control-Allow-Origin on any response (CORS test with evil origin: none) — CORS not misconfigured
- No robots.txt/sitemap (307 to login)

### Cookie flags
- authjs.session-token.{0,1,2}: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, no Secure (dev), 30-day expiry
- authjs.csrf-token / authjs.callback-url: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax

### Anomalies worth follow-up
1. `/api/health` anonymous internal status disclosure (db/storage/disk)
2. Public self-registration `/registro` (token-gated? need to test invite token requirement) and public password recovery `/recuperar`
3. Public TAE access-token pages accept arbitrary tokens (`/tae/access/test` 200 — page renders, API validates)
4. Dev mode: source paths in HTML/RSC (`/home/allopze/dev/chome/bodega/...` in error pages and katana-discovered URLs), `__nextjs_*` dev endpoints present but 404/redirect when probed
5. QA super-admin account with 12 roles/241 permissions — broad blast radius if session stolen
6. Session cookie lacks Secure flag (HTTP-only dev env; production HSTS preload present)
7. Origin mismatch: AUTH_URL localhost vs host.docker.internal — potential Host header confusion surface

ed2a46.title: Secrets & SCA evidence (verified)
ed2a46.content:
## Verified facts for reporting

### Hardcoded credentials (tracked in git, present in history)
- `scripts/dbq.mjs:3` — hardcoded Postgres DSN `postgres://bodega_dev:<redacted-hex>@127.0.0.1:5433/bodega_dev`
- `scripts/dbq.mjs:4,8` — plaintext password `Chgo1314` for `allopze@gmail.com`, sets bcrypt hash directly
- `scripts/qa-shot.mjs:7` — `process.env.QA_PASS || 'Chgo1314'` fallback
- `scripts/qa-custom.mjs:10`, `scripts/qa-debug.mjs:27`, `scripts/qa-extract.mjs:10` — password filled into login form
- All 5 files tracked (`git ls-files`), password present since commit `94c1cc4` (in history)
- `.env.local`, `.env.development.local`, `.env.qa` are gitignored (`.gitignore` lines 52, 72, 100-105, 113) and never committed — observation only

### Dependency CVEs (trivy-fs.json verified vs package-lock.json)
- `browserslist@4.28.2` installed (node_modules present), via `@sentry/nextjs@10.59.0 → @sentry/bundler-plugin-core@5.3.0 → @babel/core@7.29.7 → @babel/helper-compilation-targets@7.29.7 → browserslist`. Active at build time (`withSentryConfig` in next.config.ts).
  - CVE-2026-73088 prototype pollution → DoS, 7.5, fixed 4.28.7
  - CVE-2026-73089 unbounded cache memory growth DoS, 7.5, fixed 4.28.7
- `fast-uri@3.1.2` lockfile-only (NOT installed in node_modules; no root dep pulls it; webpack/schema-utils/ajv are peer/optional resolution records)
  - CVE-2026-13676 Unicode hostname canonicalization bypass, 7.5, fixed 3.1.3
  - CVE-2026-16221 backslash authority delimiter inconsistency, 7.5, fixed 3.1.4
  - CVE-2026-18446 host confusion via backslash authority, 7.5, fixed 3.1.5
- All CVE details from trivy DB (Red Hat refs). Web search unavailable (no API key) — trivy advisory data used as source.
- Trivy scanned target `bodega/Dockerfile` (i.e. installed node_modules layers), not the npm lockfile; versions match lockfile exactly.

### Other trivy/gitleaks/trufflehog hits = noise
- gitleaks: test-fixture strings (`submission-key-123456`, `hint_compras_v2`), doc placeholders
- trufflehog "CloudflareApiToken" = git commit hash (false positive); Postgres hits = placeholder DSNs in docs/git history of removed doc.env
